snippet.title: Powder Park: Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Every other resort builder game stops at the blueprint. Powder Park doesn't. Lay out lifts, lodges, jumps, and rails however you want, then step off the drafting table into a park that actually reacts to what you build. Visitors attend a dynamic community and you get to ride straight through it.
Grow your cozy resort, tidy up your decorations, place a new lift, and watch visitors fill in the runs you've built. Whenever you're done managing and ready to move, you can drop straight into your own mountain and ride it, solo or with friends.
Every building, board, and wipeout in Powder Park is modeled and animated by hand by an actual person on the team, a small studio still in development and building in the open. 
Powder Park puts a more cozy spin on a tycoon sandbox genre by being 100% pressure free. It's meant to be a game that's played year-round. But as we developed with plans to release during the holiday season, each budget planning mechanic, chore, or otherwise bump in the road you'd see in a normal business, we chose to buff down into a smooth, relaxing experience to take your mind off work rather than throwing you into another job. Instead of stressing, you turn a mountain into a home.
